sourceSense.definition: a diagrammatic representation of the earth's surface (or part of it)

two-winged insects characterized by active flight
flap consisting of a piece of canvas that can be drawn back to provide entrance to a tent
an opening in a garment that is closed by a zipper or by buttons concealed under a fold of cloth
having or producing a comfortable and agreeable degree of heat or imparting or maintaining heat
examples: a warm body
a warm room
a warm climate
a warm coat

sourceSense.definition: psychologically warm; friendly and responsive
examples: a warm greeting
a warm personality
warm support

sourceSense.definition: inducing the impression of warmth; used especially of reds and oranges and yellows when referring to color
examples: warm reds and yellows and orange

sourceSense.definition: (computer science) a system of world-wide electronic communication in which a computer user can compose a message at one terminal that can be regenerated at the recipient's terminal when the recipient logs in
examples: you cannot send packages by electronic mail

sourceSense.definition: a message sent over the internet via the email system
an identifier that a person uses as their identity to communicate on the email system

we took a short holiday in Puerto Rico

sourceSense.definition: a day on which work is suspended by law or custom

it's a good thing that New Year's was a holiday because everyone had a hangover

sourceSense.definition: the sound of laughing

he knows a million gags
thanks for the laugh

even a schoolboy's jape is supposed to have some ascertainable point

sourceSense.definition: writing that provides information (especially information of an official nature)
anything serving as a representation of a person's thinking by means of symbolic marks
a written account of ownership or obligation
become part of; become a member of a group or organization

sourceSense.definition: cause to become joined or linked

sourceSense.definition: come into the company of

sourceSense.definition: be the source of pain

sourceSense.definition: take in liquids
